assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production panoramic website hero background for Trip Calculate, a road-trip fuel-cost and route planning app for Ukraine and Europe.
Create a sophisticated editorial travel illustration, panoramic 3:1 composition, preferably 2400x800. An elegant winding two-lane road leads through layered Carpathian-inspired hills toward a soft distant mountain horizon. One very small unbranded warm-ivory hatchback travels along the road on the RIGHT side of the composition. Refined cut-paper shapes, gentle dimensional shading and restrained fine paper grain; contemporary travel editorial aesthetic, not toy-like low-poly trees. Palette grounded in existing brand deep teal #0e7a63, forest ink #123d38, muted sage #9bb8a4, pale mint haze, with very restrained warm ochre sunlight. Right half carries all detailed landscape, road and car. LEFT 55 percent is a quiet continuous deep forest-teal atmospheric field with only extremely subtle broad hill silhouettes, intentionally dark enough for WHITE headline and body text to be overlaid by HTML. No bright sky or detailed foliage behind left copy zone. Keep top 15 percent subdued across full width for navigation. Inviting sense of a weekend journey, calm confidence, generous breathing room. Full bleed opaque artwork. No text, letters, numbers, logos, interface, labels, borders, watermark, pins, money or charts. Not a website mockup: deliver only the background artwork.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait mobile hero background for Trip Calculate. Reference image: the previous generated panoramic teal mountain-road hero, use its exact refined painterly editorial style, fine grain, forest teal, sage hills, ivory car and warm pale golden light. Generate a NEW art-directed portrait composition, 2:3 aspect ratio. Top 60 percent must be a very quiet DARK deep forest teal atmospheric field with extremely subtle tonal hill silhouettes, suitable for white HTML headline and buttons. Keep all bright sky, detailed landscape, curving road, and a tiny unbranded ivory car in BOTTOM 40 percent. Bottom scene shows winding road through layered Carpathian-inspired hills with slender conifer trees and a glimpse of lake, warm glow concentrated bottom-right near low horizon. Composition should gracefully continue dark background into lower scene, no sharp dividing line. Sophisticated travel editorial illustration, calm and welcoming. No text, symbols, interface, watermarks, labels or frames. Full bleed opaque background.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone supporting illustration for Trip Calculate's first-trip empty state or planner introduction, landscape 3:2 canvas.
Primary request: a refined small editorial illustration of a gently folded ivory road map, with a single curved deep-teal route joining two simple circular waypoints, and one small unbranded ivory hatchback resting beside the near edge. A tiny stylized cluster of sage mountain silhouettes and two slender evergreen trees rises from the back fold, suggesting the Carpathians. One restrained ochre accent on a waypoint. No legible map labels, no national boundaries, no real cartographic claims.
Style: elegant dimensional paper illustration with subtle painted texture and soft ambient contact shadows, mature travel brand, not glossy plastic or cartoon clipart. Restrained palette #0e7a63 teal, #123d38 forest ink, sage #9bb8a4, warm ivory, small muted gold accents. Unified centered composition with generous 15% clear padding on every side. All objects connected in a single compact scene, readable when displayed 280px wide.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including all outer corners, with only very subtle contact shadow under objects. No background panel or environment.
No text, typography, logos, coins, currency, UI, borders, watermark or extra floating symbols.
